description: CAP (vnebolnichnaya pnevmoniya, J18) in adult with stated penicillin allergy. TerminologyProvider enables ATC hierarchy (J01C*) for broader exclusion vs manual map. Before: partial (only mapped drugs). After: full class exclusion including unmapped via ATC. Measurable physician benefit: prevents contraindicated beta-lactams reliably, reduces UNVERIFIABLE warnings, full traceability of terminology mapping.
